bibliographic.title: Buck Rockford Heads West
bibliographic.author: J. J. Guest
bibliographic.description:
"Bored of his life in the East, Buck Rockford heads West to seek the meaning of man's existence."

Buck Rockford Heads West is a short interactive Western. It was made in Ink for Neo-Twiny Jam with a final word count of 500 words.

"A teetotaciously authentical account of life in the Old West, written by a bona fide English gentleman." — Buford T. Catawampus, a genuine American tourist I waylaid on the London Underground, and most definitely not somebody I invented.

"I enjoyed reading your interactive fiction game. It was well-written and engaging. I think you have a talent for creating funny and memorable characters and situations. 😊" — Bing, an AI.
